hospital.why: A is the most consistently model-specific set, tracing nurse authority, tacit-knowledge loss, competing clocks, and declaration-timing games through to both patient and hospital outcomes without relying on invented precision.

toyota.why: F best connects local incentives around andon pulls and standard work to organization-wide information loss, platform risk, and adaptive failure while keeping its examples more disciplined than the other highly specific sets.

hop_aero.why: E is the only set that combines four complete answers with a sustained account of how funding clocks, costly vehicle-consuming tests, requirement creep, subsystem uncertainty, and investor-facing metrics interact.

overall_observation: The strongest sets treated formal authority, delayed feedback, tacit practice, and measurement as coupled mechanisms; polished specificity alone was not enough when exact quantities, technologies, policies, or failure modes were asserted without support.
what_separated_the_best_from_the_worst: The best sets answered all four questions with explicit multi-step chains from a named local decision to a system-level consequence and distinguished irreducible value or position conflicts from missing evidence, whereas the worst were unfinished process notes or substituted elaborate invention for grounding.
